_comment: The vibeic org's forked open-source EDA tools + their upstream sources. Discovered from the vibeic GitHub org (fork=true, parent recorded). This is the registry the fork-gatekeeper tracks.

forks.role: ALIGN sky130 PDK — carries our channel-length (L) and width (W) sizing fixes; ships in the image since 0.2.27, and the build fails unless a layout generated at L=500nm measures 500nm
analog place & route — SPICE netlist to GDS; ships in the image since 0.2.27 as the venv at /foss/tools/align, built from source rather than installed from PyPI
ASAP7 KLayout layer map — without it DRC reads the wrong layers
ASAP7 7nm predictive PDK data — /foss/pdks/asap7
ASAP7 7.5-track standard cells — the library PnR places
SAT solver — the other smtbmc backend; shipped alongside kissat
PDK version manager — installs and pins the open PDKs
Python cosim testbench
coverage for cocotb
3D/2D capacitance extraction field solver — fastercap_extract dispatches to it for parasitic extraction cross-checks. Mirrored 2026-07-31 (clone+push).

DFT/ATPG engine — `fault atpg` / `fault cut` / `fault chain` drive Phase-3 scan insertion and stuck-at coverage. Mirrored 2026-07-31 (clone+push; the fork API returns 403). Carries our fix for `chain --skip-synth` never creating the file `-o` asked for while still exiting EX_OK.
FasterCap build-time sibling — `add_subdirectory("../Geometry")`. Same story as LinAlgebra.
waveform viewer — the format reader behind every VCD/FST our cocotb and iverilog runs emit; a dump this cannot open is a failed measurement, not a passing one

PREVIEW-only 55nm open PDK (ICsprout Integrated Circuit Co. + Zhejiang University IC school + ECOS Team/ICT-CAS) — PDK data for vibe-ic's icsprout55 target (/foss/pdks/icsprout55). Production tapeout explicitly prohibited by the PDK's own README pending its first engineering-batch tapeout (Dec 2025); ships no DRC/LVS rule decks or SPICE device models as of this mirror (upstream README's own Todo list).
PDK data — /foss/pdks/ihp-sg13g2 and ihp-sg13cmos5l; the SG13G2 spm cell runs on it
RTL simulation
SAT solver — one of the two smtbmc backends behind sby
DRC / layout-edit / GDS streamout / extraction

FasterCap build-time sibling — FasterCap's own CMakeLists does `add_subdirectory("../LinAlgebra")`, so FasterCap cannot be built from our fork without it. Mirrored 2026-08-01 (clone+push; the fork API returned 403). Missing it is why the image kept consuming the base image's FasterCap: building from our fork was impossible and nobody had tried.
DRC / layout-edit / extraction
LVS
analog / mixed-signal SPICE
PDK installer — produces /foss/pdks/sky130A and gf180mcuD; every DRC and LVS run reads its libs.tech
place / route / CTS / resize / STA / PDN / antenna / IR-drop

post_merge_check.name: dup-logger-ids
post_merge_check.why: Our resistance-clamp warning in src/rcx/src/extmain_v2.cpp has been renumbered THREE times in six days because upstream grew a logger message id underneath it: 515->519 (2f9fbcd47e), 519->524 (5bb6ca31ee), 524->527 (724a389026). Every one of those merges was TEXTUALLY CLEAN — the two call sites are in different files — so git took it silently and a person found it afterwards. This is the detector that sees it, and until 2026-08-05 nothing ran it at merge time (vibeic-eda#89).
post_merge_check.note: etc/find_dup_ids.sh is the BAZEL wrapper around exactly this command and cannot run from a plain checkout: outside bazel it resolves find_messages.py to $(dirname $0)/_main/etc/find_messages.py — measured, `bash etc/find_dup_ids.sh` from the repo root exits 1 with 'Cannot find find_messages.py at .../etc/_main/etc/find_messages.py'. A merge worktree is a plain checkout, so registering the wrapper would have produced a check that is red every day for a reason that is not a collision. The command below is what the wrapper runs, and is the same command all three historical fix commits quote as their proof.

post_merge_check.name: test-registration-parity
post_merge_check.why: etc/Build.sh has defaulted to bazel since the 2026-07-29 daily merge, and the image is built with it, but our regression tests were still being written for CMake. Nothing compared the two target sets, so 27 of the fork's own tests -- including the proofs FIX_STATUS.md records for dpl, drt, fin, grt, ppl, psm, rsz and tap -- had stopped being reachable by the build that produces the binary, while the CMake run stayed green (vibe-ic#813). Registered here rather than in a program's own list so there is ONE declaration: daily_merge.py runs it before a merge is pushed, and check_fork_selftests.py runs the same command daily on the checked-out clone, which is the half a merge-triggered gate cannot reach -- all 27 arrived through our own patches, not an upstream merge.
post_merge_check.note: Runs from a plain checkout in 0.15s: it parses src/*/test/CMakeLists.txt and src/*/**/BUILD and compares the two sets. It needs no bazel, no build and no PDK, which is what makes it safe to run in a merge worktree and on every tick.

forks.role: open PDK platform data, not a tool: 17 files sparse-checked out of flow/platforms/{nangate45,asap7} and re-staged into /foss/pdks/nangate45 (all 6 files) and /foss/pdks/asap7 (11 of 20). ZERO ORFS flow logic is consumed. Pinned by ARG OPENROAD_FLOW_SCRIPTS_REF in the composing Dockerfile; 66f174f8e14f7cdd178a1e1d37c915d28ac3e24d = upstream master at 2026-08-03, mirrored as branch vibeic-orfs-pin-20260801. We carry NO commits of our own here (git rev-list --count origin/master ^upstream/master = 0), so the fork is a pure mirror.
static timing analysis — the signoff timing engine behind phase-3 STA (clean fork, no patches of ours yet)
UVM in Python
formal (SymbiYosys)
SystemVerilog front end — yosys vendors it for the modern SV path, so an elaboration it rejects is an RTL our synthesis cannot read
yosys SystemVerilog plugin (upstream renamed povik/yosys-slang -> povik/sv-elab); the SV frontend the 0.4x->0.66 roadmap makes default
SystemVerilog-to-Verilog conversion — invoked by reused_ip_rtl_consume when an ingested IP is SystemVerilog and the downstream tool is Verilog-only. Mirrored 2026-07-31 (clone+push).

Xyce's build dependency — Xyce cannot be configured or linked without it. Statically linked into eda-tool-xyce, not shipped as its own artefact, which is why it has no IMG_ pin of its own. Mirrored 2026-07-31 (clone+push) after the recorded reason for leaving it upstream — that a whole-history push fails at this size — did not survive testing: the 1.8 GB push went through.
RTL simulation (lint / fast sim)
schematic capture and SPICE netlisting — the analog A1/A2 entry point; its netlist is what ngspice simulates
parallel SPICE — the second analog engine; a corner ngspice and Xyce disagree on is a result neither has established
SMT solver — the default smtbmc engine for sby, so step-5 formal proofs resolve through it; #13 was a dangling link to exactly this
synthesis / tech-mapping / optimization
